title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-11
lineage: MSR > R > PCM > CD, plus  MSR > ? > Beta PCM > D > CD, plus MSR > R > C > D > CD

ai_review.summary: A vintage 1969 performance that dazzles with Dark Star and eclectic jams, but the soundboard tape suffers from low fidelity and digital glitches.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the early‑Dead vibe – a wild blend of R&B, country, psychedelic rock and even a Tom Constanten Bach minuet tucked between Mama Tried and Yellow Dog Story.  The show is consistently praised despite the recording’s muffled, noisy sound and noticeable CD‑burn errors that make it hard to listen to.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high show rating) is offset by consistently poor recording quality; weighted average yields a mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the audio as "crap", low‑fidelity, muffled and riddled with digital errors from a bad CD burn; overall clarity is very limited.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows like a time capsule of ’69 Dead – R&B and country tunes tumble into LSD‑freak rock, with quirky moments such as a Bach minuet between songs adding unexpected charm.

band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s surprise Bach minuet between Mama Tried and Yellow Dog Story is highlighted.
